edits.before: Q the last-hit, E the step-up, Q-recast the slowed target, hop out — a full pattern he answered with a whiff.
edits.after: Between Worlds lets you teleport across the zone — fight on its edge so the slow holds him inside while you cross out.

edits.before: Hopping IN with W and trading while his engage is still loaded — the exit spent as an entrance is how Auroras get coached postmortem.
edits.after: Holding the curse for a fatter recast at half HP hands him the Abscond window — detonate early and hop, or Kingslayer heals the trade back.

edits.before: If Sylas gets a kill, Kingslayer heals a bigger chunk per hit — stop trading and farm at max Q range. Two kills: give Abscond its full 13s before you step up, and play for zone utility.
edits.after: If Sylas gets a kill, Kingslayer heals more per hit — buy Oblivion Orb before you trade again and farm at max Q range. Two kills: give Abscond its full 13s, and play for zone utility.

edits.before: Carry through tempo — patterns that exit free compound; your zone turns objective fights into speed checks they fail.
edits.after: Carry by taxing Abscond: every 13s dash he spends reaching you is a window your Q-recast and 22s hop turn into free chunks.
